text:
Type: upholstered storage bench with lift-up lid
Use: extra seating and hidden storage by a sofa, a window or the foot of a bed; living room, bedroom, hallway
Style: traditional, classic, contemporary
Materials: woven fabric upholstery, padded seat cushion, dark-stained turned wooden legs
Colors: warm grey-beige fabric, black-brown legs
Shape: long rectangular box with a padded overhanging lid, piped seat edge, small fabric pull loop, four short turned legs, low and solid
Feel: cozy, elegant, soft, practical
Goes with: grey or cream sofas, dark wood, brass or black accents; classic or traditional living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: STOCKSUND
product.description: Storage space under the seat. The lid stays open so you can safely and easily take things in and out.
